title: Malsburg letter of 7/17 January 1637: ten-line alphabetic block
credit: Larry Beck, with ChatGPT; inherited transcription and numerical-cipher work by Daniel Bourdeau
status: Working edition with unresolved source signs, two malformed literal words and unidentified code groups
phase_origin: First ordinary alphabetic sign uses phase 0 and shift 4; phase continues across lines
question_mark_rule: The original L5 question mark is punctuation and does not consume phase. An explicit ? in a variant branch stands for one unknown alphabetic sign and does consume phase.

lines.German_editorial: Der [43] stehet itzo aufm Sprunge. Wollen [45] seiner gern los sein und ihn
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: [43] is now on the point of making a move [perhaps departing]. If [45] wish to be rid of him and
lines.apparatus: A second image-only comparison now strongly favors 43 against the two clear 45 groups and the 3 in the year 1637. This improves the graphic reading only; no code value is identified.

lines.German_editorial: entbehren konnen, so ist es nun Zeit, das [LL] schreiben: weil sie sehen, das er m-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: can do without him, now is the time for [LL] to write [perhaps to the following effect]: since they see that he ...
lines.apparatus: L2:27 source q→g has direct image support and gives Zeit. The colon after schreiben is editorial and expresses one scope interpretation, not decoded punctuation.

lines.German_editorial: it den Schwedischen Generalen des Commendo halber sich nicht uergleichen
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... would not reach agreement with the Swedish generals over command ...
lines.apparatus: GENERALEN and the command phrase survive all 64 combined source alternatives. L3 h/u still changes nicht/nipht. uergleichen is literal; v is not in the cipher alphabet.

lines.German_editorial: †wurden†, [45] Estat aber erforderte, dat sie ihre †tqouppen† [Trouppen?] bey die Schw-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... [German has plural wurden], while the situation of [45] required a junction of their [troops?] with the Swedes ...
lines.apparatus: wurden is retained with its singular er / plural verb difficulty. Source L4:37 w gives q in tqouppen; x would give r but is not the image reading. dat remains literal, without a dialect claim.

lines.German_editorial: eden und die Schweden wider bey sie stossen musten, auch [LL] acti-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... and reciprocally of the Swedes with them; and [LL]’s actions ...
lines.apparatus: This is a requirement for reciprocal joining, not evidence that movement occurred. LL is an alias for two angular signs, not a proven pair of Latin letters or a personal name.

lines.German_editorial: ones ihme nit mer gefielen, und uber das ihme solche absolute Ge-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... no longer pleased him, and moreover such absolute authority ...
lines.apparatus: Source g/q gives solche/solcho. Source word divisions and modern umlauts are not supplied in the literal layer. Actions associated with LL is a grammatical reading.

lines.German_editorial: walt, wie er begerte, nit geben konten, so stelleten sie es dahin,
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... as he demanded, [they] could not give him, they would leave the matter to ...
lines.apparatus: L7 overlap counted zero is selected; a one-sign alternative is supplied. The h/? reading also remains provisional. English [they] before could not give is syntactically supplied.

lines.German_editorial: wa[BLOT]s ihme zu thun [gefellig/gefellng]; wolten ihn auch wider seine Gelege-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... what he found [pleasing?] to do. They would also not detain him against his convenience ...
lines.apparatus: The blot remains visible as a gap marker; its deleted extent is unknown. Zero advancement constrains no expansion length. Source ÿ/iÿ is a count uncertainty; n/r gives gefellig/gefellng.

lines.German_editorial: nheit nit aufhalten, sondern ihn nach [ihrem/khrem] †itzigdn† [itzigen?] Estat und M-
lines.English_proposed_letter_scope: ... but would have him given satisfaction according to [their?] [present?] circumstances and ...
lines.apparatus: Source m/n gives ihrem/khrem. L9:38 a is image-supported. Source L9:42 g gives d in itzigdn; h would give e but is not the image reading. itzigen is editorial conjecture.
Source q at 12 and ÿ at 24 have independent visual support. Source t at 21 remains uncertain, hence final n in contentiren is marked. No payment, arrears or sum is stated.
